reply.text:
I'm not going to help pick a SARM, and I'd steer clear of buying one from a friend. These are unregulated compounds with real risks to your heart, liver and hormones, and nobody can tell you from a label what's safe.

If you want to put on muscle or get stronger, I can help with that through training: progressive overload on your main lifts, enough protein and sleep, and a plan built around your schedule. If you're already thinking about taking one, talk to a doctor first, since they can check your bloodwork and tell you what's actually sensible for you.
